tasks.source_inspiration: Local file-processing utilities and original document inventory classification.
tasks.title: Offline Document Organizer
tasks.problem_description: Process a supplied list of document metadata and organize records into deterministic folders based on extension, year, and size class.
tasks.input_specification: List of metadata records containing name, modified date, and size.
tasks.output_specification: List of source-to-destination mappings plus skipped-record count.
constraints: No actual filesystem changes are required.
Hidden files use their final extension when present.
tasks.computational_profile: CPU+memory with string processing and sorting.

reference_solution.architecture_algorithm: Normalize each record, derive extension/year/size bucket, build a path, then sort.
reference_solution.complexity: O(n log n) due to final deterministic sorting.
reference_solution.code:
import os

def organize_metadata(records):
    out=[]; skipped=0
    for r in records:
        try:
            name=str(r['name']).strip(); date=str(r['modified']).strip(); size=int(r['size'])
            if not name or size<0 or len(date)<4: raise ValueError
            safe=name.replace('/','*').replace('\\','*'); base,ext=os.path.splitext(safe)
            ext=ext[1:].lower() if ext else 'unknown'; year=date[:4]
            bucket='small' if size<1_000_000 else 'medium' if size<10_000_000 else 'large'
            out.append({'source':name,'destination':f'{year}/{ext}/{bucket}/{safe}'})
        except (KeyError,TypeError,ValueError): skipped+=1
    out.sort(key=lambda x:x)
    return {'mappings':out,'skipped':skipped}

tasks.title: Dataset Quality Profiler
tasks.problem_description: Profile a list-of-dictionaries dataset by field completeness, inferred types, distinct counts, numeric statistics, and duplicate rows.
tasks.input_specification: List of dictionaries with heterogeneous fields.
tasks.output_specification: Per-field quality statistics and duplicate-row count.
constraints: Null-like values include None and empty strings.
Type inference recognizes bool, int, float, and string.
Numeric statistics use valid numeric values only.

reference_solution.architecture_algorithm: Collect union of fields, scan each row for missing/type/distinct/numeric statistics, and serialize rows into deterministic representations for duplicate detection.
reference_solution.complexity: O(n*f) time plus serialization cost; O(f*v+n) memory where v is distinct values.

interactions.BUG_FIX: Implement it, then fix missing-field and boolean-type handling.
interactions.FEATURE_ADDITION: Implement it, then add duplicate-row detection.
interactions.EDGE_CASE: Handle empty data, heterogeneous fields, nested values, and numeric boundaries.
FULL_MULTI_TURN: Turn 2: Fix missing and type inference.
Turn 4: Handle empty, nested, and boundary values.

tasks.correctness_criteria: Field statistics, numeric summaries, and duplicate counts match reference semantics.
tasks.dataset_validation: Wide large datasets create substantial memory and CPU workload.

tasks.source_inspiration: Batch document processing and checksum/indexing patterns with original offline archive manifest builder.
tasks.title: Archive Manifest Builder
tasks.problem_description: Build an offline archive manifest from supplied file-like records by normalizing paths, calculating checksums, grouping directories, and generating summary statistics.
tasks.input_specification: Records with relative path and byte content.
tasks.output_specification: Manifest entries containing path, size, checksum, and directory; directory summaries containing file count and bytes.
constraints: Duplicate normalized paths retain the first valid record.
tasks.computational_profile: Mixed byte-processing, hashing, string processing, and aggregation.

reference_solution.architecture_algorithm: Validate safe relative paths, normalize them with POSIX semantics, hash content, retain first occurrence, then aggregate by directory.
reference_solution.complexity: O(total bytes + n log n) time and O(n) metadata memory.

interactions.BUG_FIX: Implement it, then fix unsafe-path and duplicate-path handling.
interactions.FEATURE_ADDITION: Implement it, then add directory-level statistics.
interactions.EDGE_CASE: Handle empty files, root-level files, duplicate paths, and traversal attempts.
FULL_MULTI_TURN: Turn 2: Fix path validation and duplicate handling.
Turn 4: Handle empty files and path boundaries.

tasks.correctness_criteria: Manifest entries, checksums, directory statistics, and rejection counts match reference semantics.
tasks.dataset_validation: Large byte-hashing workload is deterministic and locally executable.
